description: This file defines the Settings class for the RomRaider software, containing configuration parameters, default values, and methods for managing user preferences, window layouts, logging, and other application-specific settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Represents the comprehensive configuration settings for the RomRaider application, including UI preferences, logging configurations, ECU definitions, and various application modes.

methods.name: getWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the application window.

methods.name: setWindowSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the application window.

methods.name: getWindowLocation
methods.description: Returns the position of the application window on the screen.

methods.name: setWindowLocation
methods.description: Sets the position of the application window.

methods.name: addEcuDefinitionFile
methods.description: Adds a new ECU definition file to the list of ECU definitions.

methods.name: setEcuDefinitionFiles
methods.description: Replaces the current list of ECU definition files with a new list.

methods.name: getLastImageDir
methods.description: Returns the last directory used for images.
